fate: Killed in battle in 509 BCE against Tarquin's son Arruns; they killed each other. Marcus Brutus, Caesar's assassin, claimed descent from him.
moments: Leads the expulsion of Tarquinius Superbus
Becomes one of the first consuls in 509 BCE
Has his own sons executed for plotting to restore the king
name: Lucius Junius Brutus
summary: Led the revolt that expelled Tarquin and became one of Rome's first two consuls.
